runtime: Editor game DX11 synthetic rendered review
verdict: VISUAL SIGNOFF for the nine actually opened 720p 150%-text UI frames. No material unreadable/clipped control or allocated-text defect found in these frames.

findings.evidence: resources150 in Apollo, SELENE and Mars
findings.observation: Explicit text wrap is stable and readable. Top/bottom text cropped by the scroll viewport is expected scrolling, not an allocated-row defect. All three resource-map screenshots passed the unchanged strict layout checks.

All numbered labels are separate legible callouts. Leader lines point to unchanged actual star coordinates; the Apollo orbital texture and rescue local-world grids are identified correctly. Leader lines remain visually busy, a cosmetic limitation.

Difficulty choices, selected Professional state, factual lander status and proposed budgets are readable. Remaining content and confirmation control continue below the scroll fold; the screenshot is not a proof of an entire human confirmation flow.

SELENE and Mars show readable source/socket identifiers, text plus color, one verified connection of four and selected source B. Apollo clearly shows read-only rescue context with no active cable-action buttons.

limits: Only the nine listed PNGs were actually opened in this review; the wrapper generated sixty frames and passed 154 assertions overall.
This signoff is for Editor 1280x720 UI only. It does not claim final packaged, 1080p, continuous animation, performance or human playtest verification.
A faint background HUD/pause overlay remains visible through the dark translucent panel; readability was adequate in the inspected frames.
World rover/magnifier/sampler graphics were not part of this nine-frame signoff.
